newsitem.title: FINLAND: Stockmann says 1996 sales rose 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Stockmann says 1996 sales rose 19 pct.

text.p: Finnish retailer Oy Stockmann Ab said in a statement on Friday group sales increased 19 percent in 1996 to 7.4 billion markka.
"Stockmann's total sales in 1996 amounted to 7.4 billion markka. Compared to 1995, sales increased by 1.2 billion markka, or 19 percent," Stockmann said.
"Half of the increase came from improved sales efficiency, and half from sales in new outlets," it added.
Stockmann said its 1996 turnover will amount to over six billion markka from 5.16 billion in 1995.
Stockmann said it will publish monthly sales figures for each of its units starting in early 1997.
